user.title: Live Track Aircraft
user.description: Aircraft within the radius appear on the map as they arrive and depart on their own. Point it anywhere — it defaults to your Home Assistant location, but you can watch any airspace in the world.

data_description.location: Drag the marker to the middle of the area to watch.
data_description.radius_km: How far out counts as overhead.
data_description.max_aircraft: A safety ceiling, not a display limit. Filter the map card to show fewer.
data_description.military_areas: Optional. Every military-flagged aircraft inside these circles is drawn, past the maximum. latitude,longitude,km separated by semicolons: 39.81,-84.04,150; 34.0,-117.8,463

error.invalid_location: That point is not on the globe. Drag the marker onto the map.
error.invalid_military_areas: Each circle is latitude,longitude,km with 1 to 2000 km, at most ten, separated by semicolons.

abort.already_configured: Aircraft are already tracked for this location and radius.
